criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. A realistic-range test (reading, dispatch and introspection commits, an owner-path commit under a directory with a nested .gitattributes '* athena-exclude', an intervention adding records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json, then a job's candidate, verification and outcome; no Athena-Job trailers) yields records_only x4, declared_intervention, and job_landing carrying that job and its verification id.
criteria.evidence: land::tests::a_realistic_range_is_classified_from_content_alone passed. It builds a reading, a dispatch, an introspection, owner/notes.md under owner/.gitattributes '* athena-exclude', an intervention with a hand edit, then the landed records plus work. None of the commit messages has a trailer. It asserts [RecordsOnly x4, DeclaredIntervention, JobLanding], with job == PR_JOB and verification == RecordId(PR_JOB).

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. Blocked-then-landed: a commit adding candidate, verification and a blocked outcome is records_only; a later commit adding only outcome-landed.json plus governed work is job_landing for that job, reusing the gate's closing_jobs.
criteria.evidence: land::tests::a_blocked_outcome_is_records_only_and_the_later_landed_outcome_is_the_landing passed. It asserts [RecordsOnly, JobLanding] and that the second commit carries the job and a verification. Classification calls athena_gate::invariant::closing_jobs directly.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. Refusal tests each make pr_commits return an error containing the commit's sha: governed change that is neither intervention nor closing records; landing with no verification; landing whose outcome exists but is not landed (a real blocked outcome); owner-path commit without the exclusion.
criteria.evidence: Four tests passed, each using the refusal() helper, which asserts that the error contains the bad commit's sha: governed_change_that_is_neither_..., a_landing_without_a_verification_is_refused, a_landing_whose_outcome_is_blocked_is_refused_not_counted (a real Blocked Outcome record from fixtures::outcome), and an_owner_path_without_the_exclusion_is_refused (lacking/ has a .gitattributes that does not exclude notes.md).

summary: The change does what the retry asked. `land::pr_commits` now sorts each commit in remote_base..head by what the commit contains: it reuses the gate's `closing_jobs` (now public) for job_landing, uses a new content-only `added_interventions` for declared_intervention, refuses any other change to governed content, and calls the rest records_only. It no longer reads trailers. `GitLandingRecords::commits` copies kind, job and verification from `pr_commits` and checks each commit with validate. An intent with no job_landing commit is now refused. The reconcile fixtures in core and the CLI build real job-landing commits. records-history.md §5.3, its failure-path table and CHANGELOG.md now describe the content rules. The CHANGELOG entry lists every caller and writer with the test that covers it, or why it needed no change, and the commands that were run. I ran these myself and all passed: `cargo test -p athena-core land::` (13), `cargo test -p athena-core gh::` (57), `cargo test -p athena-core` (342 passed, 1 ignored), and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile` (2). `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` were clean. One limit: in this snapshot the commit message reads only "candidate", so I could not check the commit message body. The CHANGELOG entry does carry the full change description. run.rs and drain.rs are unchanged. Neither calls `pr_commits`, and the description says so.
